sources.title: GitHub - yangyucheng000/MobileViT
sources.snippet: MobileViT is a lightweight, general purpose transformer vision. MobileViT proposes a different perspective, using transformers as convolutions to process information. The results show that MobileViT significantly outperforms CNN and ViT based networks on different tasks and datasets.
